t: Said while making the sacrifice himself
a: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ
p: Bismillāh, Allāhumma taqabbal min Muḥammadin wa āli Muḥammadin wa min ummati Muḥammad.
m: In the name of Allah. O Allah, accept from Muhammad, and from the family of Muhammad, and from the nation of Muhammad.
